name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Shaker Mirror Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 3 layers of acrylic for a unique dimensional shaker ornament effect.
              +) Layer 1: Acrylic 3mm with 2-sided printing.
              +) Layer 2: Acrylic 4mm with laser-cut only construction to create the shaker compartment.
              +) Layer 3: Acrylic 3mm with 1-sided printing for the front decorative layer.
    - Includes custom 3mm mirror acrylic charms with cut and engraved details.
    - Charm material is available in Gold Mirror Acrylic or Silver Mirror Acrylic.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
              +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
              +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
              +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
              +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
              +) 7 x 7 in ~ 17.78 x 17.78 cm
              +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
    - Minimum charm size: 1.5 cm.
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - Produced using precision laser cutting for clean, sharp custom silhouette shapes.
    - Acrylic layer features high-quality UV printing for vibrant, detailed artwork.
    - Mirror acrylic layer uses laser engraving to display personalized names and text.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom hanging ornament for Christmas trees, room décor, gift decoration, and seasonal display.
    - Shaker-style construction allows the inner charms to move freely inside the ornament.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-lasting decorative use.
    - Suitable for custom names, dates, messages, and themed holiday designs.
    - Easy to hang with the included hanging accessories.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A charming gift for family, friends, couples, kids, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, baby’s first Christmas, family keepsakes, memorial ornaments, and holiday celebrations.
    - Great for creating personalized ornaments with names, charms, and meaningful details.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake or festive personalized gift.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 3-Layer Shaker Mirror Acrylic Ornament 

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
